rejectedNotes: Hard exclusion applied: all politics, immigration, culture-war and national-identity posts and essays dropped (keyword filter on full post text plus manual read of all 635 remaining posts). Dropped videos about him, reaction videos, Lex Clips duplicates of the full interviews, Omarchy and hardware reviews, and racing. Dropped the 2025-12 'Microservices is ... confidence scam' post: DHH says in a follow-up post that an AI wrote it from a prompt in his style, so only the follow-up is kept.
gaps: Apify account is blocked (403, outstanding invoices), so x-deep.mjs did not run; posts come from discovery plus twitter154 searches.
Code review: his standalone writing on it is thin; relies on the 2022 PR essay, the premise-trap essay and posts.
On Writing Software Well season 2 not found.
Date precision: Rails Doctrine is month only (inferred from the Rails blog's Jan 2016 mention); Rails is omakase is year only (from its URL). Video dates for all others are exact from yt-api.
On Writing Software Well #4 has no transcript on either upload, so it was dropped.
